newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil January trade balance due early February.
newsitem.headline: Brazil January trade balance due early February.

text.p: The Brazilian government hopes to be able to announce January exports and imports at the same time next month following the introduction of a new on-line import registration system, a senior trade official said.

Mauricio Cortes, secretary for foreign trade at the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, said the SISCOMEX computer system was overcoming teething problems, mainly caused by importers' unfamiliarity with the technology.

To date, Brazilian exports have been computerized and imports collated by hand, resulting in monthly export figures being announced soon after the end of the month while trade balances only became available a fortnight later.
The new system will allow monthly trade balances to be published within days of the end of the month.
